title: FVM
tagline: A cross chain loan repayment platform to repay the loan on one chain from another.
description: The project helps user to repay his loan of one chain from another chain. if a user borrowed on a protocol on one chain and wants to repay the debt from another chain since he has tokens on that chain and the gas fees is less he can do so using xRepay in a single click, removing the necessity to manually move his positions.
how_its_made:
The project is made by using hardhat, solidity, ethers and uses the knowledge of decentalised finance, cross chain bridges, technologies and gas efficient strategies.
The project helps user to repay his loan of one chain from another chain. if a user borrowed on a protocol on one chain and wants to repay the debt from another chain since he has tokens on that chain and the gas fees is less he can do so using xRepay in a single click, removing the necessity to manually move his positions.
